text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I train my body, I<n>can't train
my feelings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't keep making excuses for<n>myself. I need
to accept my own<n>weakness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep training! Don't try<n>to stop me,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: We should take this slow and steady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep training! Don't try<n>to stop me,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: We should take this slow and steady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're probably right... I need to cool<n>my head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll do as you say, so keep<n>guiding me
toward victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to slack off or<n>compromise! My next
race will be<n>one without any regrets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Also, how are you just as fired up<n>as me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, good. I'm glad we're<n>both serious
about this!
